# oneuptime_ceph_cluster (Resource)

Ceph cluster resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_ceph_cluster" "example" {
  name = "Example short text"
}
```

## Schema

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource. Computed.
- `project_id` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Computed.
- `name` (String) Name of this Ceph cluster. This is the join key — it must match the ceph.cluster.name OTel resource attribute stamped by the OneUptime Ceph Agent.. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Project Member, Settings Admin, Settings Member, Create Ceph Cluster], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Project Member, Viewer, Settings Admin, Settings Member, Settings Viewer, Read Ceph Cluster], Update: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Project Member, Settings Admin, Settings Member, Edit Ceph Cluster]. Required.

Computed.
